steps.name: 1-boot
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({nestUI: typeof NestUI, theme: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light', hasProfileForm: !!document.getElementById('profileForm'), hasPasswordForm: !!document.getElementById('passwordForm'), hasPhoneForm: !!document.getElementById('phoneForm'), hasEmailForm: !!document.getElementById('emailForm'), user: (document.getElementById('display-username') || {}).textContent})

steps.name: 3-profile-state
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({visible: !document.getElementById('profile-modal').classList.contains('hidden'), realName: (document.getElementById('editRealName') || {}).value, studentId: (document.getElementById('editStudentId') || {}).value, school: (document.getElementById('editSchool') || {}).value, major: (document.getElementById('editMajor') || {}).value, grade: (document.getElementById('editGrade') || {}).value, enrollment: (document.getElementById('editEnrollmentDate') || {}).value})

steps.name: 8-password-result
steps.eval: (function(){ var v=[]; document.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(function(e){ if(/Error$|Status$|Msg$/.test(e.id) && e.offsetParent!==null && (e.textContent||'').trim()) v.push(e.id+'='+e.textContent.trim().slice(0,90)); }); var t=[]; document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast-text').forEach(function(e){ t.push(e.textContent.trim().slice(0,90)); }); return JSON.stringify({visible: !document.getElementById('password-modal').classList.contains('hidden'), messages: v, toasts: t}); })()

steps.name: 21-wechat-result
steps.eval: (function(){ var t=[]; document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast-text').forEach(function(e){ t.push(e.textContent.trim().slice(0,120)); }); var w=[]; document.querySelectorAll('[id*="wechat" i]').forEach(function(e){ if(e.offsetParent!==null && (e.textContent||'').trim()) w.push(e.id+'='+e.textContent.trim().slice(0,120)); }); return JSON.stringify({toasts:t, wechat:w, url: location.href}); })()
